description: This file defines a React hook named useProjectCost that fetches and formats the aggregated cost of a project from a backend API. It manages state for data, loading, and error, and provides a method to refetch the data. The hook normalizes the project ID, constructs the API URL, handles fetch errors, and formats the cost for display.

methods.name: useProjectCost
methods.description: React hook that fetches and formats the total cost of a project given its ID, with options for enabling/disabling fetch and refetching data.
